title: Those Who Shed Petals
overview: Toya's need to be special borders on obsession. How far would he go to gain a talent, and what would he do once he finally has what he wants?

title: The Way of the Returner
overview: Toya may be part of The Forest of Greats now, but that won't stop people from having opinions about his talent.

title: Declaration of War
overview: Neumann mobilizes The Forest of Greats for an all-out offensive when the Tyrant King reveals himself.

title: All-knowing and Corruption
overview: The battle takes a turn for the worse. The Forest of the Greats may have formidable members, but so does the Army of the Sinners.

title: Farewell, Hearkening Soul
overview: Power has a price. Returners have great talents, but what do they lose as a result?

title: Seiya
overview: Toya faces off against the leader of the Sinners. But when Xiang Yu only wishes to talk, the line between heroes and villains begins to blur.

title: Reblooming Reincarnation
overview: Old enemies become new allies as old allies become new enemies.

title: Savior
overview: With peace an impossibility, Toya and the others must decide what to do with the three months humanity has left. Fortunately, help arrives from an unexpected source.

title: All Begins and Ends at the Seed
overview: They must all decide what happens next.

title: The Faceless Man
overview: Who is Alan Smithee and, more importantly, what does he have to do with the Branch of Reincarnation?

title: Tattered Talent
overview: While Jubei and Toya try to save Haito, coordinated attacks on Rouge Returners begin.

title: Till My Voice is Heard
overview: Albert considers herself the real Einstein, not Ein.

title: In the End of Reincarnation
overview: Toya and Haito come to a mutual understanding.
